notes: All PNG layers use the exact 894x839 source canvas.
Visible head, top-knot and beard artwork is directly extracted from the original source without resizing or repositioning.
The ears, tusks, scalp hair and side facial hair remain rigidly attached to the head.
The small top knot is a spring layer.
The central hanging beard is a subtle spring layer.
The shirt and shoulders remain in the static body layer.
A narrow hidden neck/shirt region behind the head was reconstructed only to support subtle head movement.
Tiny hidden scalp and face strips beneath the top knot and beard were reconstructed only where spring movement could reveal them.
eyes_closed.png is a full-canvas transparent blink overlay containing only the eye regions.
hair_back, hair_left and hair_right were skipped because separate loose-hair layers would add seams without enough visual benefit.
Normalized pivot coordinates use x=0 left, x=1 right, y=0 bottom, y=1 top.
